reading_evidence.limits: Every listed body was actually read in full. This does not claim reading every recursively reachable dependency or every primary PDF. Primary reading is restricted to the exact pages in primary-readings.json. The author’s whole-paper reading claims are not adopted as independent reading evidence. Existing published uniformization, harmonic regularity/Hodge, and functional-analytic suppliers remain explicit local prerequisites, not imported conclusions from the cited primary papers.

operations: Recomputed the equality of Beltrami coefficients for f∘γ and f, conformal cancellation and the conjugation representation.
Checked that conjugation by a fixed sphere homeomorphism carries uniform identity convergence back to the original group; three-point normalization converts this to Möbius parameter convergence.
Checked countable sheet summation with locally normal convergence and the L1 operator estimate.
Reconstructed the simple-pole Laurent argument and uniform puncture-tail estimate giving norm compactness of the finite-type target ball.
Checked the flat equal-area disk net, monodromy-to-intersection-graph expansion comparison, overlap mass ratio (a−η)/(a+η), and the layer-cake bound γ0−(λ^-1−1).
Checked the limiting-pushforward phase argument and contradiction; it does not require surjectivity or completeness of Poincaré series.
Checked the two invariant coefficients, their sphere gluing and conjugacy of the actual supplied cofinite model.
Checked the finite-coarea/full-limit-set argument and the complementary-interval funnel-area obstruction.
Checked the primitive peripheral correspondence and upper/lower cusp coordinate signs exp(2πiz), exp(−2πiz); no unprovided uniformization of arbitrary groups is inferred.
Checked near-two Neumann inversion and the normalized Cauchy candidate, cancellation with the sphere solution and the entire principal normalization.
Recomputed the Schwarzian derivative coefficient −6/π and the fourth-power kernel; checked bounded coefficient holomorphy and derivative control on the exterior.
Checked bounded local Cauchy primitives, their O(r log r) marked-point behavior and finite partition construction of a smooth residual.
Checked the cutoff error at simple-pole quadratic differentials and the exact bundle E=T(−P), with dual K²(P).
Checked compact Dolbeault/Serre application, pairing constants, phase representatives, the closed annihilator and complex Hahn–Banach quotient norm.
Checked stability and Riemann–Roch give the stated kernel/dimension and include the zero-dimensional stable case.
Recomputed reflection of the coefficient with its conjugation phase, reflection symmetry of the normalized sphere solution and preservation of the disk.
Checked completeness of the descended hyperbolic metric by path lifting and its curvature calculation from the actual Christoffel formula.
Checked the Shimizu iteration c_next=−c², a_next=1−ac, b_next=a², d_next=1+ac and the discrete-limit contradiction.
Checked precisely embedded cusp horodisks, properness, Schwarz–Pick finite-area bounds and the use of the supplied complete peripheral correspondence.
Checked full-ball Schwarzian fibers against the actual marked homotopy relation; checked the boundary centralizer and dense fixed-point argument.
Checked the gluing across the round circle and the use of QC null-set transport, not unproved removability of arbitrary Jordan curves.
Checked joint continuous puncture-relative geodesic homotopies through standard cusp neighborhoods.
Recomputed the right-inverse kernel with coefficient −1/2, its automorphy and the radial moment 1/((j+1)(j+2)(j+3)).
Checked the local finite-dimensional holomorphic implicit/inverse-function step, quotient neighborhood and exact fiber interfaces.
Recomputed the full coefficient rebasing Möbius formula and derivative η/(1−|μ0|²), including the fixed phase and null-set transport.
Checked separation using exact Bers fibers and near-infimum coefficients, before declaring a metric.
Checked the Cauchy subsequence, summable coefficient differences on one compact reference and the finite-chart integration of the limit complex structure.
Checked equality of metric and quotient topologies, holomorphic transitions and the explicit connected locally compact metric exhaustion/countable base.
Checked absolute periodization of the fourth-order kernels and identification of the differential kernel by annihilator inclusion and equal finite codimension.
Checked distinction between exterior Bers coordinates Q(X−) and intrinsic cotangent Q(X).
Checked the upper quotient estimate and lower near-minimum-map estimate in metric first variation; no extremal map existence is used.
Checked local continuous finite-dimensional right inverses and the explicit correction ηλ=η+Vλ(Tμ−Tλ)η for continuity of the quotient norm.
Checked coordinate rebasing of the kernel and norm, Dini length lower bound, and the analytic coefficient path tμ with speed bound κ/(1−t²κ²).
Integrated the bound to arctanh κ, took actual near-infima, and checked the stated differential-contraction-to-distance implication.

choice_audit: All ten assume full AC. Countable choice, DC, complex Hahn–Banach and AC-bearing smooth/harmonic/compactness suppliers are within that assumption; no choice-free conclusion is claimed. The finite net/lifting/coordinate constructions were checked under these actual hypotheses.
boundary: Acceptance is only of these ten Statements with their supplied stable cofinite models, labeled standard cusps and primitive peripheral correspondence where required. It does not establish generic geometrically finite deformation parametrization, skinning coderivative identification, uniform continuity or contraction over moduli, amenable-mass degeneration, combination/gluing, topology, or original hyperbolization consumers. It makes no extremal-map or shortest-path existence claim.
checks_provenance: The author’s three scoped mechanical checks are bound in the unchanged proposal; this review does not relabel those as independently rerun checks. Independent verification here consists of full proof/supplier reading, manual recomputation documented above, and exact hash/extent binding.
